subject: Ciências
description_pt: Propor iniciativas individuais e coletivas para a solução de problemas ambientais da cidade ou da comunidade, com base na análise de ações de consumo consciente e de sustentabilidade bem-sucedidas.

components.description_pt: Analisar exemplos de práticas bem-sucedidas de consumo consciente e sustentabilidade em comunidades
components.description_en: Analyze examples of successful conscious-consumption and sustainability practices in communities
components.cc_component_description: Evaluate human resource management practices based on their impact on biodiversity and sustainability

components.description_pt: Identificar problemas ambientais presentes na sua cidade ou comunidade
components.description_en: Identify environmental problems present in one's city or community
components.cc_component_description: Evaluate the effectiveness of specific individual or community actions in reducing environmental impact

components.description_pt: Propor iniciativas individuais para enfrentar problemas ambientais locais baseadas em práticas de sustentabilidade
components.description_en: Propose individual initiatives to address local environmental problems based on sustainability practices
components.cc_component_description: Evaluate the effectiveness of specific individual or community actions in reducing environmental impact

components.description_pt: Propor iniciativas coletivas para enfrentar problemas ambientais locais utilizando exemplos de consumo consciente
components.description_en: Propose collective initiatives to address local environmental problems drawing on conscious-consumption examples
components.cc_component_description: Apply scientific principles to propose strategies that minimize a specific human impact on the environment

cc_matches.description: Things that people do to live comfortably can affect the world around them. But they can make choices that reduce their impacts on the land, water, air, and other living things.
The sustainability of human societies and the biodiversity that supports them requires responsible management of natural resources.
Apply scientific principles to design a method for monitoring and minimizing a human impact on the environment.
